why: aimTicks measures how long a solution has EXISTED, never whether the gun got there, and the shot deliberately leaves along the barrel -- so without this gate a tank fires mid-slew into whatever is in front of it. Latent until idle search shipped: measured over pacifist.test.ts's 60 seeds, dropping this takes AI-on-AI shell kills from 43 to 51 on an unchanged shot count.
killedBy: stepAi friendly-fire gate at the trigger does NOT fire while the barrel is still traversing to its solution (issue #371)
